title: The Lake of Fire
lead: The final fate of the beast, the false prophet, the devil, Death and Hades, and those not found in the book of life (Revelation 19:20; 20:10, 14–15). It gathers earlier images of judgment by fire: Sodom (Genesis 19:24), the burning valley of Hinnom (Isaiah 66:24), and the "eternal fire" of Matthew 25:41 and Jude 7.
